description: Source code for GatewayDiscovery class implementing network service discovery and DNS resolution for Android, including mDNS and unicast DNS querying.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Manages network service discovery and DNS resolution for gateways over local and wide-area networks.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates local network service discovery via mDNS.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops local network service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Begins periodic unicast DNS discovery for wide-area network gateways.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a network service info into GatewayEndpoint data and updates internal maps.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways and status text.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs a status message based on current discovery results.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Generates a stable identifier for a service based on name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes service names by trimming and collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a string value from service info attributes.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Parses an integer value from service info attributes.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from service info attributes.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs DNS queries to discover wide-area gateways via unicast DNS.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Decodes the instance name from FQDN.

methods.name: stripTrailingDot
methods.description: Removes trailing dot from a domain name.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs DNS query for a specific record type, with fallback to direct resolver.

methods.name: queryViaSystemDns
methods.description: Queries DNS via the system's DNS resolver over a specified network.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Extracts DNS records from a message section.

methods.name: keyName
methods.description: Normalizes a hostname for DNS record lookup.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Indexes DNS records by name.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Finds a DNS record by name and type.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP address from DNS message.

methods.name: preferredDnsNetwork
methods.description: Selects preferred network for DNS queries, prioritizing VPN.

methods.name: createDirectResolver
methods.description: Creates a DNS resolver for specific DNS servers on the current network.

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs a DNS query over a specified network asynchronously.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a specific key's value from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Extracts a boolean value from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes a DNS TXT string from ISO-8859-1 to UTF-8.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP address via unicast DNS queries.
